name: Calmarza (Spain)
description: Blue field with white semicircles issuing from the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with a white tower bearing a red ladder and a red cap.
history: Municipal flag of Calmarza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: semicircles issuing from the hoist and the fly
ladder and cap on the tower
